parsed.explanation: The operative exposure is state-tolerated police targeting: Sections 365/365A are unenforced in court but actively used as a police lever — harassment, extortion, ignored complaints, assault under threat of arrest, and forced anal/vaginal examinations described as torture. Police are documented as the foremost perpetrators of abuses against LGBTI people, which raises both outing probability and severity; a trans visitor stopped or reported faces a hostile, extractive police force with no anti-discrimination recourse. Custody placement defaults to birth sex with a discretionary, ID-gated exception. Mitigating: no convictions documented, no universal facility or presentation ban, legal recognition exists (though bureaucratic), mixed-to-moderately-tolerant social climate (72.5% oppose punishment; official posture improving), and no documented organised sweeps or trans-specific killing pattern. This sits at high risk, above the unremedied-facility-exclusion tier's milder forms but below organised-imprisonment profiles: ~0.38.
